newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Luoding Railway in 130 million yuan bond issue. [CORRECTED 3:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: China's Luoding Railway in 130 million yuan bond issue. [CORRECTED 3:30 GMT]

text.p: China's Guangdong Luoding Railway Co has issued 130 million yuan ($15.7 million) in corporate bonds, the Financial Times said on Friday.
The three-year bonds, issued on Thursday, carried a coupon of 11 percent, the newspaper said.
Funds raised through the issue would be invested in construction of Luoding's line in the southern province of Guangdong, it said.
Construction of the line, begun in 1994, was expected to be completed this year, it said but gave no further details.
